description: Search education agencies and study abroad consultants listed on Univs Agencies by name, office country or city, study destination and language. Returns public profile details (offices by city, destinations, languages, services, reviews) and the profile URL where students contact the agency. Neutral order; no contact details.

destination.description: Study destination the agency helps with: country name or ISO code, e.g. "Georgia" or "GE".

office_country.description: Where the agency has an office: country name or ISO code, e.g. "India" or "IN". Comma-separate up to 5.

query.description: Words in the agency name or profile, e.g. "medicine" or an agency name.

name: search_agencies

error.description: Present only when the search failed.

url.description: Agency profile on univs.com, where students contact the agency

title: Search education agencies
